subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain open as the umbrella for the remaining exec/tool failure no-reply contract, or should maintainers split those leftovers into narrower canonical items after the placeholder PRs land?
rationale: Current main fixed the exact empty non-media image placeholder path, but the remaining warning and fallback behavior changes affect user-visible failure noise, replay safety, and channel delivery semantics, so automation should not choose that contract alone.

options.title: Keep as umbrella until the contract is chosen
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers land or reject the active placeholder PRs and decide whether exec-like failures with no reply should warn and whether lastToolError should suppress payloadCount=0 fallback text.

options.title: Split and close after cross-linking
options.body: Move the placeholder work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and the incomplete-turn hardening to a narrower issue, then close this issue once the unique warning-policy question is preserved elsewhere.

options.title: Narrow to placeholder only
options.body: Treat this issue as only the OpenAI placeholder regression and close it after the active placeholder fix lands, accepting that warning and fallback semantics will stay as current behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep as umbrella until the contract is chosen
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers land or reject the active placeholder PRs and decide whether exec-like failures with no reply should warn and whether lastToolError should suppress payloadCount=0 fallback text.
